input.lugar: a forest trail in the Peruvian Amazon
input.escena: a damp earth trail between dense jungle vegetation with large leaves shining with water; a woman traveler in a light rain cape, long trousers and a small backpack walks away toward the back of the trail; fine raindrops visible in the air. It must read as Peruvian jungle with a passing shower, not a storm or a movie jungle
input.clima: fine passing rain under a bright overcast sky, soft abundant light, open shadows, not darkened for drama
input.refLugar: Peruvian Amazon lowland vegetation along a trail
input.prohibir: lightning or storm, extreme mud, visible animals, movie-style lianas, sunny sky
input.extra: COMPOSITION, MEASURED: the woman walking away is small and farther along the trail: head to feet between 20% and 48% of the frame height, centred between 42% and 58% of the width. The lower half is the calm damp earth of the trail and the out-of-focus leaf, mid-dark, no bright highlights. SKY BRANDLIFT CONSISTENCY (Daniela Ferreira, SKY Blog visual system, sheet 15): believable traveler POV at eye height; luminous natural light with open shadows and whites that keep detail; natural colour where ochres, blues and skin keep their true tones, moderate contrast, no filter, no orange-teal grade, no HDR; real optical depth: the near element very out of focus with soft optical bokeh, the subject sharp; a spontaneous everyday moment, no pose. LENS: 28–35 mm equivalent, contextual and immersive.
